name: Content Scheduling & Auto-Publishing
description: Comprehensive auto-publishing and scheduling suite for creators to schedule posts, video reels, and 24h stories with calendar & queue views, timezone controls, background job processing, failure retries, notifications, and granular permission controls.
author: CreatorPulse Core Team

adminSettingsPage.title: Content Scheduling & Auto-Publishing Settings
adminSettingsPage.description: Configure publication worker check intervals, queue capacity limits, retry policies, default timezones, and automated notifications.

settingsSchema.label: Default System Timezone
settingsSchema.description: Fallback timezone applied when creator timezone is unspecified.

settingsSchema.label: Maximum Scheduled Items Per Creator
settingsSchema.description: Maximum number of active scheduled content items allowed per creator queue.

settingsSchema.label: Background Worker Check Interval (Seconds)
settingsSchema.description: Frequency in seconds for the background worker to poll and publish due items.

settingsSchema.label: Maximum Job Retry Attempts on Failure
settingsSchema.description: Number of retry attempts before marking a scheduled post permanently failed.

settingsSchema.label: Retry Backoff Delay (Minutes)
settingsSchema.description: Delay before attempting to retry a failed publishing job.

settingsSchema.label: Send In-App Notifications on Publish / Failure
settingsSchema.description: Sends system notifications to creators when scheduled content is published or fails.

settingsSchema.label: Auto-Publish Simulation Mode
settingsSchema.description: Simulates background execution in sandbox mode without external network API locks.

databaseMigrations.description: Creates plugin_scheduled_content and plugin_schedule_logs tables with RLS and index optimizations.

changes: Initial release of Content Scheduling & Auto-Publishing Add-on Plugin.
Implemented creator schedule manager with Calendar and Queue views.
Added multi-format scheduling support for Posts, Reels, and 24h Stories.
Integrated timezone conversions, background worker cron, retry engine, audit logs, and permission guards.
